# Instruction definition examples

Generated by `node scripts/describe-cpu-semantics.ts` from
[the typed definitions](../../src/components/cpus/semantics/definitions.ts).
Edit those definitions and their explanations, then regenerate this document.
See the [representation contract](instruction-semantics.md) for primitive meanings,
validation, execution bindings, and current limits. The same definitions also
generate typed instruction bodies for the bounded CPU migration.

Bodies begin after opcode selection. Chapter-owned forms include their operand
fetching and addressing. Remaining native decoders supply any declared address
or selector inputs. Declared inputs
are captured before entry. Statements are
ordered. Captures are immutable; each source and action
expansion has its own scope. Action arguments are captured in the caller before its effects. Conditional and bounded iteration blocks inherit outer
captures; local captures do not escape. Each iteration sees its own current value.
Untaken blocks and zero iterations have no effects. Named outcomes end the body.
All expressions in one flag update are evaluated before
any of its assignments. On an effect failure, completed effects remain and no
later statement runs. See the contract for which bodies are bound to CPU opcodes.

## Examples

### 68000 write selected address register

The three-bit address code names A0–A7. Selecting A7 captures its current bank; internal codes seven and eight then identify USP and SSP respectively. This selection reads S only for A7 and does not read either stack pointer yet.

```text
selected:u8 := input
contents:u32 := input
match byte selected {
  case (byte & FF) = 00 {
    write A0:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 01 {
    write A1:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 02 {
    write A2:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 03 {
    write A3:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 04 {
    write A4:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 05 {
    write A5:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 06 {
    write A6:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 07 {
    write USP:u32 := contents
  }
  case (byte & FF) = 08 {
    write SSP:u32 := contents
  }
  otherwise return outcome "unsupported"; no later effects
}
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, N, Z, V, C, T, S.

### 68000 write condition code register

CCR packs X, N, Z, V, C into bits 4 through 0. SR additionally holds T in bit 15, S in bit 13, and the interrupt mask in bits 10–8; reserved bits read as zero. Capture SR in the established order: T, S, interrupt mask, then X/N/Z/V/C. CCR writes update those five flags in place. Full SR writes then update T/S and finally the interrupt mask, preserving the existing flag object.

```text
contents:u16 := input
flags "restore condition codes" simultaneously {
  X := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0010:u16)))
  N := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0008:u16)))
  Z := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0004:u16)))
  V := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0002:u16)))
  C := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0001:u16)))
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

### 68000 write status register

CCR packs X, N, Z, V, C into bits 4 through 0. SR additionally holds T in bit 15, S in bit 13, and the interrupt mask in bits 10–8; reserved bits read as zero. Capture SR in the established order: T, S, interrupt mask, then X/N/Z/V/C. CCR writes update those five flags in place. Full SR writes then update T/S and finally the interrupt mask, preserving the existing flag object.

```text
contents:u16 := input
perform "write condition code register" {
  contents:u16 := contents
  flags "restore condition codes" simultaneously {
    X := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0010:u16)))
    N := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0008:u16)))
    Z := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0004:u16)))
    V := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0002:u16)))
    C := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 0001:u16)))
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
flags "restore system flags" simultaneously {
  T := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 8000:u16)))
  S := not(isZero(bitAnd(contents, 2000:u16)))
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write INTERRUPTMASK:u3 := low3(shiftBitsRight(contents, 8))
```

Flags preserved throughout: none.

### 68000 MOVE.B D0,D0

Capture the source before selecting the destination. Write the destination before applying the result flags; preserve its live upper bits for a byte or word.

```text
originalSource:u32 := read D0
result := low8(originalSource)
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, T, S.

  yield 2:u3
}
sourceRegister:u8 := source "select address-register storage" {
  code:u3 := sourceCode

  yield selected
}

      original:u32 := read A0
      yield original

    case (byte & FF) = 01 {
      original:u32 := read A1
      yield original
    }

      yield original

Capture the source before selecting the destination. Write the destination before applying the result flags; preserve its live upper bits for a byte or word.

```text
sourceCode:u3 := source "A6" {
  yield 6:u3
}
sourceRegister:u8 := source "select address-register storage" {
  code:u3 := sourceCode
  selected:u8 := choose isZero(bitXor(code, 7:u3)) {
    then {
      bank:u8 := source "active stack bank" {
        supervisor:flag := read S
        yield select(supervisor, 01:u8, 00:u8)
      }
      yield addWrap(07:u8, bank)
    }
    else {
      yield zeroExtend8(code)
    }
  }
  yield selected
}
originalSource:u32 := source "read selected address register" {
  selected:u8 := sourceRegister
  contents:u32 := match byte selected {
    case (byte & FF) = 00 {
      original:u32 := read A0
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 01 {
      original:u32 := read A1
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 02 {
      original:u32 := read A2
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 03 {
      original:u32 := read A3
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 04 {
      original:u32 := read A4
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 05 {
      original:u32 := read A5
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 06 {
      original:u32 := read A6
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 07 {
      original:u32 := read USP
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 08 {
      original:u32 := read SSP
      yield original
    }
    otherwise return outcome "unsupported"; no later effects
  }
  yield contents
}
result := originalSource
write D7:u32 := result
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.

}
sourceRegister:u8 := source "select address-register storage" {

  yield selected
}

      yield original

    case (byte & FF) = 08 {

Capture the source before selecting the destination. Write the destination before applying the result flags; preserve its live upper bits for a byte or word.

```text
sourceCode:u3 := source "A7" {
  yield 7:u3
}
sourceRegister:u8 := source "select address-register storage" {
  code:u3 := sourceCode
  selected:u8 := choose isZero(bitXor(code, 7:u3)) {
    then {
      bank:u8 := source "active stack bank" {
        supervisor:flag := read S
        yield select(supervisor, 01:u8, 00:u8)
      }
      yield addWrap(07:u8, bank)
    }
    else {
      yield zeroExtend8(code)
    }
  }
  yield selected
}
originalSource:u32 := source "read selected address register" {
  selected:u8 := sourceRegister
  contents:u32 := match byte selected {
    case (byte & FF) = 00 {
      original:u32 := read A0
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 01 {
      original:u32 := read A1
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 02 {
      original:u32 := read A2
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 03 {
      original:u32 := read A3
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 04 {
      original:u32 := read A4
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 05 {
      original:u32 := read A5
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 06 {
      original:u32 := read A6
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 07 {
      original:u32 := read USP
      yield original
    }
    case (byte & FF) = 08 {
      original:u32 := read SSP
      yield original
    }
    otherwise return outcome "unsupported"; no later effects
  }
  yield contents
}
result := low16(originalSource)
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

### 68000 SWAP D0

SWAP uses `0100 1000 01 000 rrr`, beside the EXT slots. Read Dn once and exchange its high and low words. Apply long-result flags before writing Dn, preserving the established execution order.

```text
original:u32 := read D0
result := bitOr(shiftBitsLeft(original, 16), shiftBitsRight(original, 16))
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write D0:u32 := result
```

### 68000 MOVE.B MEMORY,D0

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Memory EA decoding fetches extensions and stages auto-updates; later base/index calculations observe those pending values. Reject odd word/long addresses before the rejected access. After both operands pass alignment checks, commit pending registers before writing the destination. Failed source/extension accesses discard pending updates; failed destination writes retain updates and completed bytes, with flags unchanged. Memory transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writes. Only a complete write sets N/Z and clears V/C; preserve X/T/S.

resultByte0:u8 := read memory[sourceAddress]
result := resultByte0
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.

Failed source/extension accesses discard pending updates; failed destination writes retain updates and completed bytes, with flags unchanged. Memory transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap. MOVEA.W sign-extends, and both sizes preserve every flag. The destination write wins over an auto-update to the same register.

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceAddress:u32 := resolve 16-bit memory EA (mode sourceMode, register sourceCode); stage auto-updates for later operands
when lowBit(sourceAddress) {
  return data-space read alignment fault at sourceAddress; no later effects
}
resultByte0:u8 := read memory[sourceAddress]
resultByte1:u8 := read memory[addWrap(sourceAddress, 00000001:u32)]
result := concatHighLow(resultByte0, resultByte1)
destinationSupervisor:u8 := source "active stack bank" {

}
when not(not(isZero(destinationSupervisor))) {

  write USP:u32 := signExtend32(result)
}

  yield 0:u3

low:u8 := read memory[addWrap(address, 00000001:u32)]

preserved:u32 := read D0

flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.

Write the high byte then the low byte, and only then set N/Z and clear V/C. Never read destination memory; a failed write retains completed bytes and preserves flags.

```text
originalSource:u32 := read D5
result := low16(originalSource)
code:u3 := source "A2" {
  yield 2:u3
}
address:u32 := resolve 16-bit memory EA (mode 2:u3, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
when lowBit(address) {
  return data-space write alignment fault at address; no later effects
}
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
write memory[address] := highByte(result)
write memory[addWrap(address, 00000001:u32)] := lowByte(result)
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, T, S.

### 68000 MOVE.W (A0),D3

Resolve the source and reject an odd address before reading its high then low byte. After both reads, commit pending address updates and preserve the live upper word of the destination. Write the complete result before setting N/Z and clearing V/C. A failed read prevents writeback and flag changes.

```text
code:u3 := source "A0" {
  yield 0:u3
}
address:u32 := resolve 16-bit memory EA (mode 2:u3, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
when lowBit(address) {
  return data-space read alignment fault at address; no later effects
}
high:u8 := read memory[address]
low:u8 := read memory[addWrap(address, 00000001:u32)]
result := concatHighLow(high, low)
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

  C := 0:flag

write D4:u32 := result

Write the result after flags, preserving live upper Dn bits on byte/word writes. Failed writes retain flags and completed bytes.

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D2
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
result := bitXor(destination, source)
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D6
write D6:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Commit staged updates before the destination read; a failed source discards them, while a failed destination read retains them. Memory transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative sources use program space. Set N/Z and clear V/C after the reads; preserve X/T/S. Write the result after flags, preserving live upper Dn bits on byte/word writes. Failed writes retain flags and completed bytes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D6
source := sourceRegister
destinationAddress:u32 := resolve 32-bit memory EA (mode destinationMode, register destinationCode); stage auto-updates for later operands
when lowBit(destinationAddress) {
  return data-space read alignment fault at destinationAddress; no later effects
}
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
destinationByte0:u8 := read memory[destinationAddress]
destinationByte1:u8 := read memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000001:u32)]
destinationByte2:u8 := read memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000002:u32)]
destinationByte3:u8 := read memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000003:u32)]
destination := concatHighLow(concatHighLow(destinationByte0, destinationByte1), concatHighLow(destinationByte2, destinationByte3))
result := bitXor(destination, source)
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write memory[destinationAddress] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 24))
write memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 16))
write memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000002:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
write memory[addWrap(destinationAddress, 00000003:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))
```

### 68000 SUB.B D0,D0

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Copy carry/borrow into X. Failed writes retain computed flags, committed updates, and completed bytes.

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D0
source := low8(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 SUB" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
  X := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Preserve X. Do not write a result.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D2
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Preserve X. Do not write a result.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Preserve X. Do not write a result.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D4
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Preserve X. Do not write a result.

```text

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D5
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Preserve X. Do not write a result.

```text

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D5
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D7
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := subtract(left, right)
flags "68000 CMP" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := subtractOverflow(left, right)
  C := borrow(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

Read the complete source before resolving the destination. Stage both operands' auto-updates, including successive uses of the same An. Reject odd word/long addresses before committing updates. Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Copy carry/borrow into X. Failed writes retain computed flags, committed updates, and completed bytes.

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D4
source := low16(sourceRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
left := destination
right := source
result := addWrap(left, right)
flags "68000 ADD" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := addOverflow(left, right)
  C := carry(left, right)
  X := carry(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Commit before reading the destination: source failures discard updates; destination failures retain them. Transfers are high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap and distinct program-space reads. Preserve live upper Dn bits on byte/word writeback. Apply N/Z/V/C before writeback. Copy carry/borrow into X. Failed writes retain computed flags, committed updates, and completed bytes.

```text

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read A0
source := sourceRegister
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := destinationRegister
left := destination
right := source
result := addWrap(left, right)
flags "68000 ADD" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := addOverflow(left, right)
  C := carry(left, right)
  X := carry(left, right)
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write D6:u32 := result
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Capture the bit-number register or complete immediate word before resolving the tested operand. Test modulo 32 for Dn and modulo 8 otherwise. Set only Z from the original bit; BTST omits writeback and may read program space or a dynamic form's immediate byte. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

bitNumber := low8(bitRegister)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := destinationRegister
mask := 00000001:u32
iterate bitAnd(bitNumber, 1F:u8) times with mask {
  yield shiftLeft(mask, 0:flag) as the next mask
} // Zero iterations retain the initial value and perform no body effects.
flags "68000 tested bit" simultaneously {
  Z := isZero(bitAnd(destination, mask))
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
```

### 68000 ASR.B QUICK,D0

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

destinationCode:u3 := input

destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, topBit(original))
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := lowBit(original)
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
count := select(isZero(sourceCode), 08:u8, zeroExtend8(sourceCode))
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, lowBit(original))
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := extendBit
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D0
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D7
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := initialExtend
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, extendBit)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := lowBit(original)
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D7
write D7:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
count := select(isZero(sourceCode), 08:u8, zeroExtend8(sourceCode))
destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
count := select(isZero(sourceCode), 08:u8, zeroExtend8(sourceCode))
destinationRegister:u32 := read D5
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := or(overflowBit, xor(topBit(original), topBit(result)))
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D5
write D5:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D0
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := destinationRegister
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u32 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := or(overflowBit, xor(topBit(original), topBit(result)))
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write D3:u32 := result
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D1
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := initialExtend
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, extendBit)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D2
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D2
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := destinationRegister
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u32 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write D0:u32 := result
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D3
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := initialExtend
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, extendBit)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := lowBit(original)
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D6
write D6:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D3
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D5
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := initialExtend
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, extendBit)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D5
write D5:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D4
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, topBit(original))
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := lowBit(original)
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D4

destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := destinationRegister
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u32 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {

flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {

  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
write D0:u32 := result

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D4
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D6
write D6:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D5
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D2
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, topBit(original))
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := extendBit
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D2
write D2:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D5
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D1
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D1
write D1:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D6
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D5
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := initialExtend
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, extendBit)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D5
write D5:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Capture the count before reading the operand, including aliased registers. Quick zero encodes eight; register counts use six bits; memory shifts once. Capture X after the operand read. Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D7
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D3
destination := low8(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u8 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftRight(original, topBit(original))
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := lowBit(original)
  next carryBit := lowBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D3
write D3:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

destinationCode:u3 := input

destinationRegister:u32 := read D0
destination := destinationRegister
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u32 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag

  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit

write D0:u32 := result

Carry the result, X, C, and accumulated ASL sign-change overflow through the loop without flag writes. Zero counts still set N/Z, clear V, and preserve X; ROX copies X to C, while other zero-count shifts clear C. Ordinary rotates preserve X. Resolve the operand once and check word alignment before committing pending address updates. Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
countRegister:u32 := read D7
count := bitAnd(low8(countRegister), 3F:u8)
destinationRegister:u32 := read D6
destination := low16(destinationRegister)
initialExtend:flag := read X
shifted:u16 := destination
extendBit:flag := initialExtend
carryBit:flag := 0:flag
overflowBit:flag := 0:flag
iterate count times with shifted, extendBit, carryBit, overflowBit {
  original := shifted
  result := shiftLeft(original, 0:flag)
  next shifted := result
  next extendBit := topBit(original)
  next carryBit := topBit(original)
  next overflowBit := 0:flag
} // Update all values together; zero iterations retain their initial values without body effects.
result := shifted
flags "68000 shift result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := overflowBit
  C := carryBit
  X := extendBit
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
preserved:u32 := read D6
write D6:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Flags preserved throughout: T, S.

Commit before reading memory. Failed reads retain committed updates but not new flags; failed writes retain flags and completed bytes. Preserve live upper Dn bits on partial writes.

sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input

destination := low8(destinationRegister)

  Z := isZero(destination)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag

result := bitOr(destination, 80:u8)
preserved:u32 := read D7
write D7:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFFFF00:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

Read the full word source before the destination; reject odd addresses before reading or committing updates. PC-relative sources use program space. Commit source auto-updates only after result/flag effects, including before requesting a synchronous exception. Failed source reads discard updates. Multiply the source by the low destination word, replacing Dn with the full 32-bit product before setting N/Z and clearing V/C. Preserve X.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceAddress:u32 := resolve 16-bit memory EA (mode sourceMode, register sourceCode); stage auto-updates for later operands
when lowBit(sourceAddress) {
  return program-space read alignment fault at sourceAddress; no later effects
}
sourceByte0:u8 := read program memory[sourceAddress]
sourceByte1:u8 := read program memory[addWrap(sourceAddress, 00000001:u32)]
source := concatHighLow(sourceByte0, sourceByte1)
original:u32 := read D1
result := multiplySigned(low16(original), source)
write D1:u32 := result
flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
  N := topBit(result)
  Z := isZero(result)
  V := 0:flag
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
```

### 68000 DIVU.W D0,D0

Read the full word source before the destination; reject odd addresses before reading or committing updates. PC-relative sources use program space. Commit source auto-updates only after result/flag effects, including before requesting a synchronous exception. Failed source reads discard updates. Clear C before testing the divisor. Zero commits the source update and requests divide-by-zero without reading Dn, preserving X/N/Z/V. Otherwise divide Dn.L by the source word, truncating toward zero with a remainder of the dividend's sign. Overflow sets V and preserves Dn/X/N/Z. Success writes remainder:quotient into Dn before setting N/Z from the quotient and clearing V/C; preserve X.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D0
source := low16(sourceRegister)
flags "68000 division carry" simultaneously {
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
when isZero(source) {
  return outcome "divide-by-zero"; no later effects
}
dividend:u32 := read D0
quotient, remainder := divideUnsigned(dividend, source)
// Truncate quotient toward zero; remainder follows dividend sign. Both results have divisor width.
quotientOverflow:flag := quotient does not fit the unsigned divisor width
// Zero divisor returns "divide-by-zero". Overflow continues with truncated results; the caller decides whether to write them.
when quotientOverflow {
  flags "68000 division overflow" simultaneously {
    V := 1:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
when not(quotientOverflow) {
  write D0:u32 := concatHighLow(remainder, quotient)
  flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
    N := topBit(quotient)
    Z := isZero(quotient)
    V := 0:flag
    C := 0:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, T, S.

Read the full word source before the destination; reject odd addresses before reading or committing updates. PC-relative sources use program space. Commit source auto-updates only after result/flag effects, including before requesting a synchronous exception. Failed source reads discard updates. Clear C before testing the divisor. Zero commits the source update and requests divide-by-zero without reading Dn, preserving X/N/Z/V. Otherwise divide Dn.L by the source word, truncating toward zero with a remainder of the dividend's sign. Overflow sets V and preserves Dn/X/N/Z. Success writes remainder:quotient into Dn before setting N/Z from the quotient and clearing V/C; preserve X.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D0
source := low16(sourceRegister)
flags "68000 division carry" simultaneously {
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
when isZero(source) {
  return outcome "divide-by-zero"; no later effects
}
dividend:u32 := read D2
quotient, remainder := divideUnsigned(dividend, source)
// Truncate quotient toward zero; remainder follows dividend sign. Both results have divisor width.
quotientOverflow:flag := quotient does not fit the unsigned divisor width
// Zero divisor returns "divide-by-zero". Overflow continues with truncated results; the caller decides whether to write them.
when quotientOverflow {
  flags "68000 division overflow" simultaneously {
    V := 1:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
when not(quotientOverflow) {
  write D2:u32 := concatHighLow(remainder, quotient)
  flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
    N := topBit(quotient)
    Z := isZero(quotient)
    V := 0:flag
    C := 0:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, T, S.

Commit source auto-updates only after result/flag effects, including before requesting a synchronous exception. Failed source reads discard updates. Clear C before testing the divisor. Zero commits the source update and requests divide-by-zero without reading Dn, preserving X/N/Z/V. Otherwise divide Dn.L by the source word, truncating toward zero with a remainder of the dividend's sign. Overflow sets V and preserves Dn/X/N/Z. Success writes remainder:quotient into Dn before setting N/Z from the quotient and clearing V/C; preserve X.

```text
sourceMode:u3 := input
sourceCode:u3 := input
destinationMode:u3 := input
destinationCode:u3 := input
sourceRegister:u32 := read D6
source := low16(sourceRegister)
flags "68000 division carry" simultaneously {
  C := 0:flag
} // Preserve unlisted flags.
when isZero(source) {
  return outcome "divide-by-zero"; no later effects
}
dividend:u32 := read D4
quotient, remainder := divideSigned(dividend, source)
// Truncate quotient toward zero; remainder follows dividend sign. Both results have divisor width.
quotientOverflow:flag := quotient does not fit the signed divisor width
// Zero divisor returns "divide-by-zero". Overflow continues with truncated results; the caller decides whether to write them.
when quotientOverflow {
  flags "68000 division overflow" simultaneously {
    V := 1:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
when not(quotientOverflow) {
  write D4:u32 := concatHighLow(remainder, quotient)
  flags "68000 result" simultaneously {
    N := topBit(quotient)
    Z := isZero(quotient)
    V := 0:flag
    C := 0:flag
  } // Preserve unlisted flags.
}
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, T, S.

### 68000 DBHI D0,label

Capture the condition before fetching the complete displacement word. If true, leave Dn and target untouched. Otherwise decrement only the low word; FFFF falls through without validating the target. For every other result, reject an odd target before changing Dn. Select a valid target before writing the counter, preserving live upper Dn bits and every flag.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
c:flag := read C
z:flag := read Z
base:u32 := read sequential fetch cursor
offset:u16 := fetch complete native-order word
target := addWrap(base, signExtend32(offset))
when not(and(not(c), not(z))) {
  counter:u32 := read D0
  result := subtract(low16(counter), 0001:u16)
  when not(isZero(subtract(result, FFFF:u16))) {
    when lowBit(target) {
      return program-space fetch alignment fault at target; no later effects
    }
    select instruction target target for successful retirement; preserve the sequential fetch cursor
  }
  preserved:u32 := read D0
  write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
}
```

For every other result, reject an odd target before changing Dn. Select a valid target before writing the counter, preserving live upper Dn bits and every flag.

code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
c:flag := read C
base:u32 := read sequential fetch cursor
offset:u16 := fetch complete native-order word
target := addWrap(base, signExtend32(offset))
when not(not(not(c))) {
  counter:u32 := read D0
  result := subtract(low16(counter), 0001:u16)
  when not(isZero(subtract(result, FFFF:u16))) {
    when lowBit(target) {
      return program-space fetch alignment fault at target; no later effects
    }
    select instruction target target for successful retirement; preserve the sequential fetch cursor
  }
  preserved:u32 := read D0
  write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
}
```

### 68000 SCS MEMORY

Resolve and read the byte destination, committing its auto-updates before the read. Then test the captured condition flags in native order. Write FF when true or 00 when false, including unchanged bytes; preserve flags and live upper Dn bits. A failed read retains address updates; a failed write retains completed effects.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
destinationAddress:u32 := resolve 8-bit memory EA (mode mode, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
destinationByte0:u8 := read memory[destinationAddress]
destination := destinationByte0
c:flag := read C
result := select(not(not(c)), FF:u8, 00:u8)
write memory[destinationAddress] := result
```

### 68000 SPL MEMORY

Resolve and read the byte destination, committing its auto-updates before the read. Then test the captured condition flags in native order. Write FF when true or 00 when false, including unchanged bytes; preserve flags and live upper Dn bits. A failed read retains address updates; a failed write retains completed effects.

code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
destinationAddress:u32 := resolve 8-bit memory EA (mode mode, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
commit staged address-register updates in first-use order; repeated registers receive their final staged value
destinationByte0:u8 := read memory[destinationAddress]
destination := destinationByte0
n:flag := read N
result := select(not(n), FF:u8, 00:u8)
write memory[destinationAddress] := result

### 68000 DBGE D0,label

Capture the condition before fetching the complete displacement word. If true, leave Dn and target untouched. Otherwise decrement only the low word; FFFF falls through without validating the target. For every other result, reject an odd target before changing Dn. Select a valid target before writing the counter, preserving live upper Dn bits and every flag.

```text

code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
n:flag := read N
v:flag := read V
base:u32 := read sequential fetch cursor
offset:u16 := fetch complete native-order word
target := addWrap(base, signExtend32(offset))
when not(not(xor(n, v))) {
  counter:u32 := read D0
  result := subtract(low16(counter), 0001:u16)
  when not(isZero(subtract(result, FFFF:u16))) {
    when lowBit(target) {
      return program-space fetch alignment fault at target; no later effects
    }
    select instruction target target for successful retirement; preserve the sequential fetch cursor
  }
  preserved:u32 := read D0
  write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
}
```

v:flag := read V
z:flag := read Z
result := select(not(and(not(z), not(xor(n, v)))), FF:u8, 00:u8)
write memory[destinationAddress] := result

### 68000 PEA control EA

Resolve the control address without reading its data or requiring even alignment. Preserve flags. Select the active stack after resolving the address. Check stack alignment, write the address high byte first, then commit that stack bank.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
target:u32 := resolve 32-bit memory EA (mode mode, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
stackSupervisor:u8 := source "active stack bank" {
  supervisor:flag := read S
  yield select(supervisor, 01:u8, 00:u8)
}
when not(isZero(stackSupervisor)) {
  stack:u32 := read SSP
  stackAddress := subtract(stack, 00000004:u32)
  when lowBit(stackAddress) {
    return data-space write alignment fault at stackAddress; no later effects
  }
  write memory[stackAddress] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 24))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 16))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000002:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 8))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000003:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 0))
  write SSP:u32 := stackAddress
}
when not(not(isZero(stackSupervisor))) {
  stack:u32 := read USP
  stackAddress := subtract(stack, 00000004:u32)
  when lowBit(stackAddress) {
    return data-space write alignment fault at stackAddress; no later effects
  }
  write memory[stackAddress] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 24))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 16))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000002:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 8))
  write memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000003:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(target, 0))
  write USP:u32 := stackAddress
}

### 68000 RTS

Select and capture the active stack before reading. Check its alignment, read the complete return long high byte first, then validate and select the target. Only after target selection, advance the original stack bank by four. Failed reads and odd targets leave the pointer unchanged; preserve every flag.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
displacement:u8 := input
stackSupervisor:u8 := source "active stack bank" {
  supervisor:flag := read S
  yield select(supervisor, 01:u8, 00:u8)
}
when not(isZero(stackSupervisor)) {
  stackAddress:u32 := read SSP
  when lowBit(stackAddress) {
    return data-space read alignment fault at stackAddress; no later effects
  }
  targetByte0:u8 := read memory[stackAddress]
  targetByte1:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000001:u32)]
  targetByte2:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000002:u32)]
  targetByte3:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000003:u32)]
  target := concatHighLow(concatHighLow(targetByte0, targetByte1), concatHighLow(targetByte2, targetByte3))
  when lowBit(target) {
    return program-space fetch alignment fault at target; no later effects
  }
  select instruction target target for successful retirement; preserve the sequential fetch cursor
  write SSP:u32 := addWrap(stackAddress, 00000004:u32)
}
when not(not(isZero(stackSupervisor))) {
  stackAddress:u32 := read USP
  when lowBit(stackAddress) {
    return data-space read alignment fault at stackAddress; no later effects
  }
  targetByte0:u8 := read memory[stackAddress]
  targetByte1:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000001:u32)]
  targetByte2:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000002:u32)]
  targetByte3:u8 := read memory[addWrap(stackAddress, 00000003:u32)]
  target := concatHighLow(concatHighLow(targetByte0, targetByte1), concatHighLow(targetByte2, targetByte3))
  when lowBit(target) {
    return program-space fetch alignment fault at target; no later effects
  }
  select instruction target target for successful retirement; preserve the sequential fetch cursor
  write USP:u32 := addWrap(stackAddress, 00000004:u32)
}
```

### 68000 MOVEP.W (d,A0),D0

Capture An before fetching the signed displacement. Transfer high byte first at alternate addresses, with 32-bit logical wrap; odd addresses are legal. A store captures Dn after the displacement fetch. A load replaces Dn only after all bytes arrive, preserving its live upper word for MOVEP.W. Preserve An and every flag.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
base:u32 := read A0
displacement:u16 := fetch complete native-order word
address := addWrap(base, signExtend32(displacement))
resultByte0:u8 := read memory[address]
resultByte1:u8 := read memory[addWrap(address, 00000002:u32)]
result := concatHighLow(resultByte0, resultByte1)
preserved:u32 := read D0
write D0:u32 := bitOr(bitAnd(preserved, FFFF0000:u32), zeroExtend32(result))
```

A store captures Dn after the displacement fetch. A load replaces Dn only after all bytes arrive, preserving its live upper word for MOVEP.W. Preserve An and every flag.

```text
mode:u3 := input
code:u3 := input
base:u32 := read A4
displacement:u16 := fetch complete native-order word
address := addWrap(base, signExtend32(displacement))
source:u32 := read D5
result := low16(source)
write memory[address] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
write memory[addWrap(address, 00000002:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))
```

Flags preserved throughout: X, N, Z, V, C, T, S.

### 68000 MOVEM.W list,MEMORY

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

address0:u32 := resolve 32-bit memory EA (mode mode, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands

    return data-space write alignment fault at firstAddress; no later effects

    result := low16(source)
    write memory[address0] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))

    write memory[address1] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
    write memory[addWrap(address1, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))
  }
  address3 := select(lowBit(shiftBitsRight(mask, 2)), addWrap(address2, 00000002:u32), address2)
  when lowBit(shiftBitsRight(mask, 2)) {
    source:u32 := read D2
    result := low16(source)
    write memory[address2] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
    write memory[addWrap(address2, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))
  }
  address4 := select(lowBit(shiftBitsRight(mask, 3)), addWrap(address3, 00000002:u32), address3)
  when lowBit(shiftBitsRight(mask, 3)) {
    source:u32 := read D3
    result := low16(source)
    write memory[address3] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
    write memory[addWrap(address3, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))

    result := low16(source)
    write memory[address4] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 8))
    write memory[addWrap(address4, 00000001:u32)] := low8(shiftBitsRight(result, 0))

### 68000 MOVEM.L list,-(A0)

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

Flags preserved throughout: X, N, Z, V, C, T, S.

### 68000 MOVEM.L list,-(A7)

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

### 68000 MOVEM.W MEMORY,list

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

### 68000 MOVEM.W PROGRAM,list

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

### 68000 MOVEM.L (A7)+,list

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

### 68000 MOVEM.L PROGRAM,list

Fetch the register mask before resolving the address. An empty list still fetches EA extensions but checks no alignment and updates no base. Otherwise check the first transfer's alignment before touching registers or memory. Visit selected D0..D7,A0..A7, reversed for predecrement stores. Capture each source and select each A7 bank at its own turn. Transfer high byte first with 32-bit logical wrap; PC-relative loads use program space. Word loads sign-extend into the complete register. Commit the captured base bank only after the whole list succeeds: a stored base keeps its original value, and the final postincrement pointer wins over a loaded base. Failure retains earlier transfers but skips the final base update. Preserve every flag.

address0:u32 := resolve 32-bit memory EA (mode mode, register code); stage auto-updates for later operands
